source_row.stem: A nurse repositions a client using a draw sheet rather than dragging the client across the bed. This technique primarily reduces:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Friction and shear forces on the skin, which contribute to pressure injury development","B":"Primarily fall risk, a concern more directly tied to bed rail use and ambulation aids","C":"Carrying no real relevance to the client's skin integrity during a routine repositioning task","D":"Primarily infection risk, a concern more directly tied to hand hygiene and aseptic wound technique"}}
source_row.rationale: Using a draw sheet to reposition rather than dragging a client reduces friction and shear forces on the skin, both of which contribute significantly to pressure injury development.
source_row.source_name: AHRQ — Pressure Injury Prevention, Friction and Shear
